summary: Cinematic cover keeps the vehicle complete and text in the left safe area. Native title, date and fictional-data disclosure are legible.
Side profile preserves vehicle proportions. Range, wheelbase and boot volume have separate units; long-range CLTC and operating qualifiers are retained.
The seating fact leads; materials and controls follow at measured heights. Deliberate Chinese phrase breaks avoid dangling fragments. Cabin photograph remains a separate layer.

The native 18-minute value is dominant, with 10–80% and long-range-only qualification nearby. Home AC time remains unspecified; device/temperature and excluded waiting time remain in the footer. No section collision remains.
Headlamp detail and road context have distinct roles. Dark roof, split lamp, body lines, handle and rounded-corner descriptions remain text; fictional imagery limitation is visible.
Native bar chart uses a zero baseline, 38/31/21/10 percentage labels and one focal bar. Sample 240, single-choice method and fictitious/non-research limitation remain visible.
Native table compares prices, range and charging; numeric columns align right. Shared 2950 mm / 520 L specifications appear below. Missing standard charge time remains explicit; only 620 km is bold.
Three chronological dates align with actual events. Free booking, unspecified stores and limited/unspecified delivery regions are retained.
Two comparable warranty scopes share a reading band. 5 years/120,000 km and 8 years/160,000 km each retain the first-to-occur condition. Unprovided terms are visible below.
Closing offer retains the standard starting price, long-range price and booking date as native text. No new performance or availability promise was introduced.

Compared the full fictional source with the current ten-page export. Removed redundant navigation and repeated range page; material features, values, conditions, survey method, version differences, dates and warranty limits remain accessible. The teal/serif identity follows this reference only. The repetition audit has no findings; that is not an aesthetic or authorship certification.
